# Kavolith Group

> An Intelligence Systems Company engineering AI systems for revenue, operations, and workforce automation. Based in Hyderabad, India.

Kavolith Group operates four brands: Kavolith (AI systems engineering services), CogniLeads OS (AI Revenue Intelligence Platform), Kavolith Intelligence (Enterprise AI Workforce Platform, presale), and Kavolith Automation (automation engineering).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Group overview and the four brands.
- [Kavolith](/kavolith): Core services — systems audit, custom workflow builds, intelligence layer. Tiers from ₹23,000.
- [CogniLeads OS](/cognileads-os): AI Revenue Intelligence Platform. Capture, score, route, convert. ₹1,20,000–₹2,50,000 per deployment.
- [Kavolith Intelligence](/kavolith-intelligence): Enterprise AI Workforce Platform — multilingual digital employees. Coming soon, presale open.
- [Kavolith Automation](/kavolith-automation): Lead routing, invoicing, and CRM sync automation packages.
- [About](/about): Background, principles, and location.
- [Contact](/contact): Consultation request form.
